description: Seat61 train route guide for a city pair (e.g. london to paris): guide title, section headings and its timetable and fare tables as rows of cells, plus the guide URL, from seat61.com. Tables only, not the guide's prose; timetables are Seat61's summaries, check the operator before travel. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: travel_seat61_routes
title: Travel Seat61 Routes
